name: Crispy Potatoes
steps: Cut potatoes into uniform chunks (around 1 inch)
Boil potatoes with baking soda for 10 min, then drain of water and rough up the potatoes
Season potatoes with salt, add oil (optional heat in oven), black pepper, and any dry seasonings
Roast for 1 hour, mixing every 20 minutes (preferably on top of parchment paper)
Combine an emacerated garlic herb oil mix, and mix the ready potatoes directly in oil
